name: RFIs and drawings
summary: Turns a site question about the drawings into an RFI in the project's own system, opens it to the designer, and tracks the answer. Crons read and draft; a person approves every open.

by-hand.evidence: 4 construction calls describe raising RFIs by hand, from site to designer and back

covered_by.question-raised: draft (the skill writes the question, the draft cron creates the RFI)
covered_by.drawing-check: skill (reads drawings and specs against the question)
covered_by.send-to-designer: approval (the open to the designer waits for a person)
covered_by.receive-response: intake (the answer status is read back)
covered_by.variation: gap (cost and time impact and the variation docket are not mapped)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: RFIs changed in each watched Fieldwire or Procore project since the last run.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Create each new question as an RFI draft with its question text, then queue the open to the designer for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reading RFIs, creating an RFI in draft, and setting its question text. Opening an RFI moves it to open and makes Fieldwire or Procore notify the assignee, so it is a live operation and waits for a person. In Procore the draft is created with draft set to true and only the queued update (draft false, assignee, due date) opens it.

fieldwire.covers: RFI list and changes, RFI draft with question, queued open to the designer

procore.covers: RFI list and changes, RFI draft created with its question, queued open to the assignee

gaps: Fieldwire: the Fieldwire-Version header is a date the kit cannot read from the spec; it is a required setting. Sign-in is a bearer token supplied directly, since the short-lived JWT exchange is not built.

Paging: the changed-RFI list is followed through Fieldwire's has_more and last_synced_at headers, up to 20 pages. A window longer than that is refused and the watermark is held, so no changed RFI is skipped, and the intake log says so; a window that stays that long is refused on every run until someone narrows it.
Fieldwire: the mapped create call takes a name only, so the question text is set by a second update call. The RFI status word for open (mapped_status) is not confirmed on a live account.
Chasing an RFI that is past due is not built: the reminder and the status word for open are not confirmed on a live account, so there is no chase cron yet.

Bluebeam: markups and revisions are mapped as partial support and it has no RFI register. No adapter. Drawing revision checks stay a skill step until its field names are confirmed against the vendor spec.

Procore: the adapter is built from Procore's own RFI reference page (read 11 Nov 2026) and tested on a fake network only. Not confirmed on a live account: that an RFI created with draft true notifies nobody, that the update with draft false is what opens it and notifies the assignee, the date-range separator in the filters[updated_at] value (sent as start...end), and paging (the pagination page did not load, so the list is paged by page and per_page and a page shorter than per_page ends it). Sign-in is a bearer token supplied directly (PROCORE_ACCESS_TOKEN) with the company id in PROCORE_COMPANY_ID. Set procore, not fieldwire, in settings; setting both is refused.

Procore: every RFI needs an RFI manager (rfi_manager_id) and a question; a question row on a business with no manager set is parked with that reason. Assignee ids are Procore user ids. Procore's RFI has no free-text message on open, so the row's message is not sent.
Cost or time impact and the variation docket have no mapped operation. The paper day docket is a manual step.
Judgment steps (reading drawings and specs, deciding which question goes to which designer) belong to the agent skill, not to the crons.
Every adapter is docs-only until a sandbox Fieldwire or Procore project proves it.

evidence.calls: 4 construction calls in the RFI worklist name these steps; the variants pass read 9 calls in total
evidence.platforms: Fieldwire, Bluebeam and Procore help and product pages mapped step by step (construction-x-rfis-platforms.json)
